configurations.//: Fourth isolated dev server (own port AND own dist dir) for the WorldPulse panel copy pass; 3000/3007/3011 are all taken by other chats.

configurations.//: Serves the feat/resume-integration worktree. The worktree has no node_modules of its own, so this runs the primary checkout's next binary against the worktree directory (same pattern as scroll-dealt/story-copy). Own directory means its own .next, so only the port is unique. Remove when the branch lands.
configurations.name: resume-integration
